body:
## DoFCraft 1.0.4

Camera and lens lists are easier to browse.

- Separate **User Camera Profiles** and **Default Camera Profiles** sections; user profiles appear first and empty sections stay hidden.
- Lens lists are sorted by increasing focal length, using the minimum focal length for zooms. Editing a lens or changing its distance scale no longer moves it to the bottom.
- Compact camera-picker summaries show bullets, up to three lenses and an “and N other lenses” count.
- The camera picker no longer repeats the current focus distance. Distance-scale units appear only when they differ from the app's unit family.
- Updated English and Russian labels and documentation.

Android 8.0+ · Fully offline · English / Russian.

Download **DoFCraft-1.0.4.apk** below. The attached SHA-256 file lets you verify the download.

This APK uses the same permanent production signing certificate as versions 1.0.1–1.0.3. Existing production-signed installations can update in place with their profiles and preferences preserved. Private Debug builds use a different certificate.

---

### По-русски

Профили камер разделены на стандартные и пользовательские; пользовательские показаны первыми. Объективы отсортированы по фокусному расстоянию независимо от шкалы дистанции и порядка редактирования. В выборе камеры показаны три объектива с буллетами и количество остальных; текущая дистанция убрана, единицы шкалы остаются только при отличии от единиц приложения.

Release-установки версий 1.0.1–1.0.3 обновляются поверх с сохранением профилей и настроек.
name: DoFCraft 1.0.4

## DoFCraft 1.0.3

DoF Master is now **DoFCraft — Depth of Field & Hyperfocal**.

- Updated Android launcher name and About screen in English and Russian.
- Refreshed the project documentation and public download page.
- The app icon and all calculator features remain unchanged.

This is an update to the existing app: the Android application ID, production signing certificate and stored data identifiers are unchanged. Existing production-signed installations can update in place without removing the app.

Android 8.0+ · Fully offline · English / Russian.

**Installation:** download `DoFCraft-1.0.3.apk`. A SHA-256 checksum is attached. Private Debug builds use a different signature; do not uninstall one if you need its saved profiles.

The public repository keeps its historical URL. Source code and the experimental Macro archive remain private.

body:
## DoF Master 1.0.1

The first public, production-signed Release APK of DoF Master for **Android 8.0 and newer**.

Calculate depth of field and hyperfocal distance with six sharpness criteria, custom camera profiles, lens-based input shortcuts, a visual DOF diagram and independent diffraction / close-focus information.

- Fully offline: no internet permission, advertising, analytics or accounts.
- English and Russian interfaces, light and dark themes.
- Debugging disabled; development preview/test activities excluded.
- Optimized Release build signed with a permanent production key.

### Download and install

Download **DoF-Master-1.0.1.apk** below, open it on your Android device and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.

If you previously installed a private Debug build, this Release uses a different signing certificate and cannot update it in place. **Do not uninstall the old copy if you need its saved profiles**: uninstalling can erase app data. Future production releases will reuse the Release signing identity.

### Verify the download

APK size: **1,886,160 bytes** (about 1.9 MB).

SHA-256:

```text
866ee34841a15839f6566df3e3af46220ab0b545c342a476a46f631054203b74
```

The attached checksum file can be checked with `shasum -a 256 -c DoF-Master-1.0.1.sha256` from the folder containing both downloaded files.

Signing certificate SHA-256:

```text
cbfdebe0362a27c425046bd6eda81cd1520d7e63c20b5d4c714cbff9b8c5fa97
```

### Validation

219 JVM tests passed. Release and Debug builds completed successfully, Release lint found no errors, and the signed Release passed an emulator smoke test covering DOF, hyperfocal results and manual-distance confirmation.

[App page](https://github.com/karrrphoto-hub/DoF-Master) · [Русское описание](https://github.com/karrrphoto-hub/DoF-Master/blob/main/README.ru.md)
